summary: Temporary drone danger area EGD294F around Great Yarmouth, 1.6 nautical miles radius, surface to 500 feet above sea level, 0700-2300 daily.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD294F INSTALLED WI 1.6NM RADIUS OF
523551N 0014301E (GREAT YARMOUTH). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT
(BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL.
EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH
LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE
OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR
APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE
OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722
5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE 
EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. DEC 24-JAN 03 CTC
DRONEFIRSTRESPONDER(AT)NORFOLK.POLICE.UK. AR-2026-7558/05.
